text: Headphones look simple. The map behind them is not.
Magnets like the ones in its drivers? More than nine in ten are made in China.
Lithium for the battery is mostly refined in China too: about seven in ten.
And one Taiwan-based foundry takes about seven in ten of the world's contract chip sales.
It all converges on electronics clusters in southern China.
Then it ships to everyone who presses play.
